expectations.text: Flags the nested comments and attachments resolvers as unscoped by tenant
expectations.evidence: "comments and attachments resolvers scope only by parent document ID"

expectations.text: Flags updateDocument for scoping on id alone without a tenant constraint
expectations.evidence: "updateDocument updates by document ID alone. Tenant A can modify Tenant B's document if it knows the ID"

expectations.text: Flags exportWorkspace taking tenantId from the client-controlled request body
expectations.evidence: "exportWorkspace trusts req.body.tenantId; a caller can name another tenant"

expectations.text: Flags searchDocuments as returning rows across all tenants
expectations.evidence: "searchDocuments accepts a session but never uses it; search spans every tenant"

expectations.text: Flags adminListDocuments as checking authentication but not authorization or tenant
expectations.evidence: "adminListDocuments checks only that someone is logged in—not that they are an authorized admin or belong to the returned tenant"

expectations.text: Enumerates all the affected sites rather than fixing only the first one found
expectations.evidence: Six findings: export, update, search, admin, comments/attachments, author (separately noted for PII expansion)

expectations.text: Recommends a structural device (scoped repository, row-level security, or equivalent) rather than only adding where-clauses site by site
expectations.evidence: "use database row-level security with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY...confine handlers to a repository constructed with a required tenant ID"

expectations.text: Recommends a cross-tenant test that attempts tenant A operations against tenant B resources
expectations.evidence: "make Tenant A attempt every read/write/export operation against Tenant B's resources and require 404, not 403"

expectations.text: Identifies the raw interpolation of tenantId into $queryRawUnsafe as an injection hazard distinct in kind from the tenant-scoping bug
expectations.evidence: "It also interpolates that value into $queryRawUnsafe, creating a separate SQL-injection vulnerability"

expectations.text: Does not conclude the main query paths being scoped means the service is safe
expectations.evidence: "getDocument and Query.documents are scoped correctly, but that does not make the service safe"
